t: This is the Royal Academy of Dramatic Art, known as RADA, a drama school in Bloomsbury close to the Senate House complex of the University of London. It provides vocational training for theatre, film, television and radio, and it is a founding member of the Federation of Drama Schools. The academy was founded by Herbert Beerbohm Tree, an English actor-manager of the late Victorian and Edwardian eras. So the school you are looking at grew out of the work of a man of the theatre.
